title: 1998 AHSME Problem 10
statement: A large square is divided into a small square surrounded by four congruent rectangles as shown. The perimeter of each of the congruent rectangles is \(14.\) What is the area of the large square?

solutions.text: If a rectangle has sides \(x,y,\) then \(2x+2y=14,\) so \(x+y=7.\) The large square has side \(x+y,\) hence area \(7^2=49.\) The correct answer is A.
hints: Let the sides of one rectangle be \(x\) and \(y\)
The side length of the large square is \(x+y\)
